hypothesis: The published-score corpus, read through the metric's linear form, identifies which geophysical channels carry credit for UNMAPPED faults; a channel model of that credit can then place dots where no sibling raster has ever drawn one.
mechanism: DTI = TP/(0.2D+0.8N) is linear in a latent per-cell credit field (alpha+beta=1, binary prediction), and for a linear model c(x)=b+w.phi(x) the bag sum over a raster's dots equals D times the bag mean, so 132 published scores reduce EXACTLY to a weighted regression on per-file feature means (28 channels: the 19 official bands + 9 structural transforms).
mimic_non_fault_process: Aeromagnetic flight-line crossover and gridding artifacts are linear, high-contrast in tmi_vg / rtp edges, and coincide with gravity edges where the survey boundary steps; a scarp-step + gravity-edge coincidence therefore flags sensor geometry as readily as it flags a fault. Secondary mimics: differential compaction lines at lithologic contacts and incised linear drainage, both of which produce white-tophat topographic steps with no displacement.
